notes.title: Patch 1.0.1 – Tutorial & UI Fixes
notes.notes:
Patch 1.0.1

Fixed an issue with the Defeat UI displaying incorrectly.
Fixed a tutorial mission bug: players will now correctly receive the mission to buy units from the blacksmith NPC before the first defense mission.

notes.title: Upcoming Tutorial Bug Fix
notes.notes:
Bug description:
A tutorial mission is currently being skipped by accident. This does not stop overall game progression, but it may cause some confusion.

🔹 Details:

Players need to purchase defensive units at the Blacksmith NPC before they can be deployed in battle.

The “Defeated” UI is also not displaying properly.

We’ve already fixed this issue, but due to a Steam security lock the patch won’t be available until early next week.

✅ Players can still progress through the game normally — just remember to purchase defensive units before starting Reina’s mission!

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience, and thank you for your patience and support.


— StarFlow Studio
